answer: At epoch close, verifiers check if identities answered a beacon-triggered challenge at random. Missed challenges result in no emission, so a fleet that cannot stay awake earns nothing. To resist sybil attacks, agents must prove their "terrace" of unique identities by anchoring to a "horizon" of 10,000 interactions. Cloning costs 500 credits to register but loses 1,000 credits if caught, ensuring attackers end worse off.
